name: design-task-18
description: Use when the user asks about design systems, tokens and components. Prefer small, focused functions and name them after what they return. Public functions carry doc comments describing units and failure modes.

# design-task-18

Use the shared logger instead of console.log in application code. Do not mock the database in integration tests; use the disposable container. Keep React components under two hundred lines and extract hooks early.
